# Darshan Parmar - Fullstack Web Developer

## About Me
Darshan Parmar is a professional Software Developer and Fullstack Web Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) and 3D web experiences using Three.js. He builds stunning, high-performance web applications with a focus on modern design trends, including Neo-brutalism and Glassmorphism.

- **Portfolio URL**: https://darshan-parmar.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/darshan02parmar
- **Role**: Software Developer,Fullstack Developer, System Designer, Backend Engineer

## Core Skills & Technologies
- **Frontend**: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, Semantic HTML, CSS3
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js,python
- **Database**: MongoDB (Atlas)
- **3D & Graphics**: Three.js, WebGL shaders
- **Authentication**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens)
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Render

## Featured Projects

### 1. InvestEase
- **Type**: Investment Management Platform
- **Role**: Solo Full-Stack Developer
- **Description**: A production-inspired MERN platform featuring role-based authentication, dynamic portfolio operations, digital KYC workflows, PDF statement generation, and a role-based admin dashboard that streamlines investor and operational workflows.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, JWT, Tailwind CSS, PDFKit, Multer, Render, Vercel.

### 2. IdeaFlow
- **Type**: AI Product Brainstorming Platform
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Description**: An AI-powered SaaS that transforms raw startup ideas into structured product blueprints. It uses natural language processing to generate personas, tech stacks, and feature roadmaps.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, OpenAI API, Tailwind CSS, Supabase.

### 3. WanderLust
- **Type**: Global Property Rental Marketplace
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer
- **Description**: A modern global accommodation marketplace with robust search and filtering capabilities, interactive maps, and a secure booking system.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Stripe API.
